2Q26 Prelim Result Beat Consensus, but Below MSe
Reaction to earnings

spans.html: UnchangedImpact to our thesis↑ Modest upsideFinancial results versus consensus— Largely unchangedDirection of next 12-month consensus EPS

spans.content: Source: Company data, MS

Estun reported prelim 1H26 net profit of Rmb150-180mn (vs. Rmb7mn in 1H25). The midpoint implies 2Q26 NP of Rmb67mn (vs. net loss of Rmb6mn in 2Q25, -31% QoQ), above consensus but below MSe. Growth was driven by:
- GPM improved both YoY and QoQ, supported by improved product mix (higher contribution of large payload industrial robots) and lower expense ratio from the optimization of operations.
- Fair value gain from the restructuring of Nanjing Technical and Nanjing Chemical Fibre.
Estun's 1H26 prelim non GAAP NP is expected to reach Rmb60-75mn (vs. loss of Rmb18mn in 1H25). The midpoint implies 2Q26 recurring NP of Rmb48mn (vs. loss of Rmb22mn in 2Q25, +149% QoQ).
Estun Automation Co Ltd (002747.SZ, 002747 CS)

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Estun Automation Co Ltd (002747.SZ)

For its core business, we apply 50x 2027e P/E, below its historical two-year forward P/E average of 65x, appropriate given its lower margin profile and our separate valuation of the humanoid business.

For the humanoid business, we apply 15x to our 2028e sales forecast of Rmb680mn, reflecting its plan to acquire the remaining stake in Codroid. This is below the ~20x average for leading humanoid OEMs, given Estun's smaller scale and market share.
Risks to Upside
■ Stronger-than-expected growth in China's industrial robot market and faster-than-expected pace of market share expansion
■ Faster-than-expected cost reduction in core components for robots
Risks to Downside
■ Slowdown in China's industrial robot market and aggressive price competition
■ Slowdown of advanced manufacturing capex and China's investment in new infrastructure
